war_summary: War 139 is on day 110 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated on the flanks — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many rear hexes; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse and others — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the previous snapshot (~3h ago), Endless Shore remains the most active region (49 events/24h, with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Woodbind, The Overland, Old Jack Tar) and shows a near-even 5-5 split with massive accelerating casualties (~600/hr per side in the last 2h window). Oarbreaker has cooled somewhat since its surge (45 events/24h, latest event ~3.5h old) but saw heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge, and Partisan Island. Marban Hollow is surging with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Sanctum and The Spitrocks and very high accelerating casualties (~450/hr per side). Callahan's Passage shows extreme accelerating casualties (~300/hr per side) with recent flips at Overlook Hill and Scáth Passing, though its latest event is ~6h old. Olavis Wake is a major hotspot with the highest current casualty rate (~800/hr Colonial, ~640/hr Warden) following the Ilmari Bridge flip. Godcrofts remains a tight 5-4 Warden-lead knife-fight (25 events/24h at Saegio, Argosa, Isawa). Secondary fronts include Clahstra (11 events, heavy casualties), Onyx (11 events), Mooring County (12 events at Borderlane), Speaking Woods, and Stlican Shelf, though several of these have gone quiet in the last few hours. Quiet rear regions remain static and unlikely to change hands.
